reviews.title: Regret Buying.
reviews.text:
Things 3 is missing basics that Apple's free Reminders app already has. There are no location-based reminders, no photo attachments, and no shared lists. For a premium-priced app, that's hard to justify.

The Reminders integration is a problem too. Things deletes what was in Reminders instead of working alongside it. Compare that to Mela's grocery lists. Mela stays in sync with Reminders, updating the text and notes inside each reminder without wiping anything out. That's the bar, and Things doesn't come close.

Updates are rare. When they do arrive, they just adapt the app to new hardware layouts. Then nothing else changes until the next device launch.

I've bought every version of this app. I regret investing in Cultured Code.


*UPDATE*

Thank you for the response. I've contacted your team many times. The answer is always some version of "you're using it wrong."

I follow your release notes by RSS. I know the roadmap.

Shared lists, location reminders, photo attachments. Reminders has shared lists for free. Things migration option is a one-time copy. It's not “sync.” These are well documented issues CulturedCode has ignored from its customers. 

This app is so rigid, it’s not a good fit for casual or power users. I've paid for each version, on each device, for years. Things just isn't worth the time spent working around a stale take on GTD.

reviews.title: Be ready to spend a lot and not be able to share with others
reviews.text:
I saw all the great reviews and was super excited to buy this app and organize my life! And yes, it’s a great app to organize projects and tasks however it has some serious shortcomings, especially given the exorbitant costs. 

First, you can’t share with a family member so having a shared family to do list in one app is impossible with this app. The only work around is sharing a log in, which then floods your phone with notifications for someone else’s tasks! Come on, sharing seems like a fundamental function.

Second, say you don’t care about sharing but want an app for your Mac. I mean after all your integrated into this app, why wouldn’t you?! Yeah that’s going to cost you ANOTHER $50. That is absolutely insane and a primary reason I’m abandoning this app and recommending others who are looking for a to do app look elsewhere. 

Great app, lacks basic sharing functionality and is incredibly greedy.

reviews.title: Not Available on Windows
reviews.text:
I use Apple products for almost everything except work, where I’m required to use a Windows laptop. Not being able to access Things 3 on Windows or even through a web interface is a major obstacle and dealbreaker.

I genuinely love Things 3. It’s one of the best designed task managers available. However, many professionals operate in mixed ecosystems, and the lack of any Windows or web access in 2026 is absolutely ridiculous. Even limited or read only web access would solve a large part of the problem.

As it stands, the Apple only restriction makes Things 3 impractical for anyone who needs cross platform access for work, which is disappointing.

reviews.title: Useless app
reviews.text:
Honestly, this app is very demotivating to use. Even though I paid for it, the overall appearance is poor and not visually appealing, especially when compared to the iPhone Reminders app.

The notification system is ineffective, and the layout is poorly designed. Because of this, I chose not to purchase the Mac version, as I don’t want to spend more money on something with such poor design and usability.

Overall, this is a very disappointing app.

reviews.title: Search needs to be overhauled! 😡
reviews.text:
Searching for anything but a single word doesn’t find it, but more importantly, it doesn’t highlight it in the title or in the notes. So if you have long notes, good luck finding your search term!

Can’t search for part of a word or even two words. For example: if the todo is named “Exercise: walk, climbing” and I search for “walk climbing”, it will find NO RESULTS. This is ridiculous.

Contacted support but it’s been ages without a fix over multiple versions. This worked fine previous but the last few versions have removed the normal searching and replaced it with this extremely broken version.
